steps.answer:
Recorded h1: When batch size goes up, tail_heaviness goes higher. On these runs it is inconclusive. batch size 8 against 1: tail_heaviness 2.8086 against 2.7079, a gap of 0.1007. The gap is inside the seed spread within one setting (1.6831).
To settle it: 6 runs, batch size at 1 and 4, 3 seeds each, everything else as here. It is refuted if the higher batch size setting gives the lower tail_heaviness on every seed.
